NameAffixes.Name: Titles in actor names
NameAffixes.Hint: What templates add to the actor's name. Roles in brackets tell the players who the enemy is, so by default only titles such as Sergeant are added. The GM sees every template on the token badge.

Stacking.Name: Stacking templates
Stacking.Hint: How several templates on one actor combine. Layers: a role, a threat level, a rank, each group of traits and each background add up, but two templates from the same layer take the highest value (Boss and Legendary give WS +20, Warlord and Boss give WS +20); penalties always add up. Add up: everything adds. Highest value: only the strongest bonus and the strongest penalty count. Characteristics change at once; skills and talents follow the mode when templates are added or removed.
